info.description:
University Management System. Run Auth → Login as admin/instructor/student first; test scripts store tokens.

After `npm run db:seed`, paste offering IDs from stdout into collection variables (fullOfferingId, prereqOfferingId, conflictOfferingId, oneSeatOfferingId, openOfferingId).

Health is on the origin (`{{origin}}/health`), not under `/api/v1`.
